name: dark-fb
description: DARK-FB - Professional Facebook Bot with Anti-Ban Protection, Multi-Provider Authentication, and Advanced Features

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm start"
scripts.build:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.deploy: echo 'Deploy to Render using render.yaml' && echo 'Repository: https://github.com/onlynewsao-cmyk/DARK-FB'
scripts.deploy:render: echo '1. Push to GitHub: git push origin main' && echo '2. Deploy will be automatic via Render webhooks'
